caption: The drawing depicts a sofa from three views: the top, front, and side elevations, all rendered in black ink on a beige background with selective use of brown and red-orange for emphasis on the sofa’s wooden elements and outlining. The top view shows the oval shape of the sofa’s seat and back, with simple detailing. The front view displays the sofa’s gently arched back and armrests, three detailed turned wooden legs in the front—decorated with vertical fluting—and similar legs at each end. The visible upholstery area is lightly shaded. The side view reveals the sloping armrest and back profile, showing an S-curve and additional turned detail on the front leg, with the sofa seat’s rectangular shape extending backward. Annotations in the upper right provide information on the sofa’s style, materials, origin, date, dimensions, and the drawing’s scale, along with the location (Metropolitan Museum of Art). Red ink is used for measurement lines and arrows, and for the dimensions “79 1/2” and “27” and “36 1/4”, indicating the width, depth, and height of the sofa respectively. The drawing is labeled "Scale Drawing of Sofa: Mahogany and Satinwood Sheraton Style," and includes credits and accession information.
title: Sofa
